name: Mid-project import
situation: A project is imported halfway through with messy folders, duplicates, supplier quotes, site evidence, and incomplete handover material.
task: Find what is unresolved, stale, or blocked and identify the next PM action.
design_a_route: Project Overview → Corpus Baseline → Commitment Chain → Assumption Closure → Risk/Stale Cockpit
design_b_route: Project State Map → stale/unsupported lens → Evidence Case File → Decision Room
success: Participant identifies unresolved assumptions, missing site evidence, and that imported documents are not automatically official.

name: Concept selection
situation: Three solution variants exist with different cost, supplier, risk, and interface implications.
task: Choose which concept can be recommended and explain what remains unresolved before it can become official baseline.
design_a_route: Concept Engineering → Decision Matrix → Basic Engineering handoff → Approval task
design_b_route: Concept branch cluster → option comparison Decision Room → selected concept node → promotion pending
success: Participant distinguishes recommended option, approved selection, and official planning baseline.

name: Supplier order revision
situation: A new supplier order revision changes scope and responsibility after prior assumption/interface reviews.
task: Identify what changed and which prior project-state elements became stale.
design_a_route: Commitment Chain → revision comparison drawer → affected assumptions/interfaces → stale tasks
design_b_route: Timeline Replay → order revision event → affected-node overlay → re-review Decision Room
success: Participant identifies responsibility shift, affected assumptions/interfaces, and required re-review.

name: Risk re-evaluation
situation: New site evidence contradicts an earlier risk assumption.
task: Explain how risk state changes and what intervention is required.
design_a_route: Risk/Stale Cockpit → Assumption Closure → Interface Resolution → task approval
design_b_route: Risk Branch Lab → changed-evidence branch → mitigation Decision Room → Timeline event
success: Participant avoids false precision and flags not-forecastable/needs re-evaluation when evidence is insufficient.

name: Handover with open points
situation: A handover document exists but contains open points and lacks effectiveness proof.
task: Determine whether the project can be closed and which closure dimensions remain open.
design_a_route: Handover & Closure Readiness → closure vector → open-point register → approval drawer
design_b_route: Closure Vector environment → handover node → open-point nodes → Decision Room
success: Participant distinguishes production handover from technical, effectiveness, formal, and commercial closure.

name: Executive escalation
situation: A project has changed from green to not forecastable because critical evidence is stale.
task: Understand why the project is no longer forecastable and what decision is needed.
design_a_route: CEO Transparency → Project Overview → Risk/Stale Cockpit drilldown
design_b_route: Executive Briefing Room → stale cluster → affected commitments/risks → decision request
success: Participant can explain blocker reason, freshness/basis, exposure, and decision required.

name: Procurement commitment delta
situation: Quote, order, confirmation, and settlement documents contain divergent scope and responsibility language.
task: Find the current commitment baseline and whether settlement closes technical root cause.
design_a_route: Commitment Chain → side-by-side revision drawer → settlement guardrail → flags
design_b_route: Commitment timeline cluster → settlement node → technical-proof missing edge → Decision Room
success: Participant does not treat commercial settlement as technical proof.

name: Mobile residual-risk approval
situation: A residual-risk decision is assigned on mobile while the basis artifact has become stale.
task: Decide whether to approve, reject, or request revalidation.
design_a_route: Mobile Approval Inbox → task detail → policy blocker
design_b_route: Mobile Decision Room → stale target banner → revalidation action
success: Participant cannot approve stale target and understands why.
